The '''JA-3 Speeder''' was a type of speeder available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The JA-3 Speeder was a gift given to all ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' subscribers through the mail starting [[September 12]], [[2013]] through [[October 20]], 2013.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''
